name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3417: REG-1144. The second eye looked at v3414 AT FULL REACH and returned 6 findings; 4 were real, 1 refuted by measurement, 1 a latent weakness in my own gate. At the shipped 9,000-char cap this look was impossible: control_ui.html, the file the whole version is about, never reached the eye. (1) HIGH, an empty counts object was a CLEAN heart on screen and a MISSING row in the doctor, on the identical payload, because {} is TRUTHY in JS and FALSY in Python - so his chip showed a healthy heart while the row beside it reported failure AND misdescribed what his screen said. That is v3414 own defect class committed inside v3414. The chip now counts the keys. (2) MEDIUM, two painters reach the chip with no ordering and v3414 added a third path, so an overlay census followed by a failing deferred read flipped the chip to not taken while the overlay still showed the census it had just drawn. Not taken is a claim about whether a census has EVER arrived, and once one has, it has; guarded, and this deliberately REVERSES a v3414 gate case which now carries the reason. (3) LOW, the boot title promised a live census under a not-taken label. (4) LOW, an absent key printed as a measured zero in the row whose whole subject is that mistake. REFUTED: the eye reported the stylesheet rule missing; it is at line 6208 and the payload had stripped the comment block it sits in. Its structural half was real - the gate check was a whole-file substring search a COMMENT could satisfy - and now strips block comments with a BOUNDED pattern. Gate grows to 17 cases and 7 RED_PROOFs, including a corroborator that runs the shipped JS painter in node and the shipped Python row over the same six payloads and asserts they never disagree.
